{{Quote|Constrictor to Rebel forces. We surrender. Please bring up rescue craft. Our engines are on fire. And please don't fire on our escape pods.|Unidentified Constrictor captain to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="WS" />}}
A [[Captain/Legends|'''captain''']] served in the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and commanded the ''[[Constrictor]]'', a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]]. The captain helmed the vessel at the [[Battle of Talasea]] and later surrendered to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] after suffering heavy damages.<ref name="WS" />
